title.zh: 劳资关系（为本法目的的雇员）公告 1988
title.en: Industrial Relations (Employees for the Purposes of the Act) Notification 1988

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Notification is the Industrial Relations (Employees for the Purposes of the Act) Notification 1988.

heading.en: Categories and classes of Government employees

text.en: 2. The categories, classes or descriptions of the following officers and servants of the Government mentioned in the Schedule are declared to be employees for the purposes of the Act.

THE SCHEDULE
Paragraph 2
(1)
All monthly-rated employees in Division IV of the public service.
(2)
Government Daily Rated Employees.
(3)
Clerical Officer Grade I.
(4)
Clerical Officer Grade III.
(5)
Clerical Officer Grade IV.
(6)
Statistical Assistant Grade III.
MINISTRY OF DEFENCE
(7)(a)
Senior Public Health Inspector.
(b)

(c)

(b)

(9)
Chief Nursing Officer.
